neighbours.label: ' press' and ' news' used as the journalism modifier of an event or item (press conference, news conference, press release), and French 'conf' in conférence: the media-briefing word, as opposed to journalism contexts without those words and 'press' as a machine or verb
fire: The mayor announced the new budget at a press conference on Tuesday.
At a news conference in Paris, the minister defended the reform.
Le président a parlé lors d'une conférence de presse à Bruxelles.
The company confirmed the merger in a press release this morning.
Police gave few details at a brief news conference outside the station.
La conférence des évêques s'est tenue à Lyon cette année.
The striker said at his farewell press conference that he would miss the fans.
Officials will hold a news briefing at noon to update the public.
quiet: The mayor announced the new budget to reporters on Tuesday.
Speaking to journalists in Paris, the minister defended the reform.
Le président a parlé aux journalistes à Bruxelles.
The company confirmed the merger in a statement this morning.
Police gave few details to the reporters gathered outside the station.
La réunion des évêques s'est tenue à Lyon cette année.
The striker told reporters after his last match that he would miss the fans.
The old printing press in the cellar still works on special days.
